text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Okay, the butter is melted. What comes
next
again?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Braids
text_block_list.text: O-oh! I'll put in the carrot powder now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer is helping some younger
students
bake in the kitchen. It all
started when her
curiosity got the best
of her.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Hair Tied Back
text_block_list.text:
N-no way! Palmer?! Wh-what are you
doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer and I heard the commotion, so
we came
to see what you guys were up
to in the kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So, what's the sitch?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Hair Tied Back
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, um... We're trying to bake gifts
for
someone...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Braids
text_block_list.text:
But we've never made cookies before.
We
accidentally burnt a batch and
started freaking
out... Sorry for causing
such a ruckus!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Hey, it's all G! Here, let me
help!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you all busy and stuff makes me
wanna
join in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So that's how we started baking with
them, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That should do for the dough. Now let's
roll it
out!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Braids
text_block_list.text:
Yuck! Why is it so salty?! Oh no... I
must've put
salt in the dough instead of
sugar...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It happens! This is your first time
baking
cookies, after all. But I think
they'll still make for
great gifts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The salty cookies will be great for
sodium
replenishment, and they'll be a
treat for the taste
buds in combo with
the sweet ones I'm making!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Braids
text_block_list.text: Palmer... You're the best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There, got it. You can move now! Hehe! I
can't
believe you didn't notice you had
flour on your
nose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're so dialed in, it's adorable! I'd
legit give
you the world, girl. You're just
too presh.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Hair Tied Back
text_block_list.text: Y-y-you would?! Swoon...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There, they're ready! Okay now, say
"ahhh."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whatcha think? Pretty good for a trial
batch,
yeah?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Braids
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes, ma'am! They're very good! So
good!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Your face is all red... Oh no, was
that still
hot when I fed it to you?! I'm so
sorry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All done! Whoa! They're picture perfect!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Now all you gotta do is muster up the
courage to
give them to your special
person! I hope whoever
you're giving
these to likes them!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Hair Tied Back
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Gotta muster up the courage...

U-um, Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Please accept our cookies!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait, what? You're giving them to me?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Hair Tied Back
text_block_list.text:
Yes, um... You see, we wanted to make
cookies
for you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Hair Tied Back
text_block_list.text:
I know it's kinda weird to get a gift that
you
helped make...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Hair Tied Back
text_block_list.text:
But... we had so much fun baking with
you. It was
a real treat working alongside
you! I guess in a
way, this is a thank-you
gift, too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait, no cap? Are you two really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh, I'm sooo honored! Thanks a
mil!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I could tell exactly how much love and
care you
both put into these just from
watching you work...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the cookies and the great
memories
too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'll treasure—and savor—your precious
feelings!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Hair Tied Back
text_block_list.text:
Urk! M-my heart... can't handle it!
P-Palmer... You
feed us fans so well...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Hair Tied Back
text_block_list.text:
Urk! M-my heart... can't handle it!
P-Palmer... You
feed us fans so well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Stamina? Oh, you mean like how long
they spent
cooking?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh man, look at you. Your forehead's all
sweaty.
Here, I'll help you wipe that off!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Hair Tied Back
text_block_list.text: E-eep! I-it's okay! I can do it myself!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Hair Tied Back
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Last I heard, there's a rumor going
around that
Mejiro Palmer's
no-holds-barred fanservice is
bewitching
fans left and right in the academy...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Hair Tied Back
text_block_list.text:
F-for sure! You get it, don't you,
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Braids
text_block_list.text:
It's wonderful how nice yet oblivious she
is! Her
racing is incredible too, of
course, and I just want
to cheer for her
forever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you guys are so fired up! I dunno
what for,
but thanks, I guess?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Last I heard, there's a rumor going
around that
Mejiro Palmer's
no-holds-barred fanservice is
bewitching
fans left and right in the academy...
